ESP32 Mac 128K Flasher

Puts ESP32 Mac 128K on a plain ESP32 dev board (NodeMCU-32S / ESP32-DevKitC) over USB. Firmware (1592 KB, md5 5fdf2e7e) is built in.

1Check this browser

Checking...

2Plug in and connect

  • Use a USB-C cable that carries data (many charging cables don't).
  • Close anything else using the board: the Meshtastic web client or app, Arduino Serial Monitor, other flasher tabs.
  • Click Connect and pick the board. On Windows it shows as CP210x, Silicon Labs or CH340 (COM port); on a Mac, usbserial or wchusbserial.

3Flash

⇅Back up or clone a board (optional)

A backup is an exact copy of the whole board: the firmware, your ROM, every disk in the library and the Wi-Fi settings. Restore it later, or write it onto a second ESP32 board to make a clone. Connect first (step 2).

A backup holds your Wi-Fi password and your Apple ROM, so keep the file to yourself.

4First start

The board restarts by itself (if it doesn't, press EN once. The blue LED blinks slowly while it starts and then breathes once it's ready). Then join the Wi-Fi hotspot ESP32-Mac-Setup (password heltecmac), open http://192.168.4.1, pick your home network, and upload your ROM and a disk on the page it shows next.

5Watch the board start (optional)

Shows what the board prints while it starts: Wi-Fi, memory and whether the Mac started. Useful if it gets stuck. Click Disconnect above first if you're still connected for flashing.




?If it won't connect or flash


The board isn't in the list, or nothing happens
    

  • Try another cable or USB port (a port on the computer itself, not a hub).
    • 

  • Windows needs the USB driver for the chip next to the USB socket: CP210x from Silicon Labs (silabs.com, search "CP210x VCP drivers") or CH340 from WCH (wch-ic.com). After installing, unplug and replug the board.
    • 

  • On Linux, add yourself to the dialout group, then log out and back in.
    • 



"Failed to connect" or it stops at "Connecting..."
    

  • Put the board in download mode by hand: hold BOOT, tap EN, let go of BOOT. Then click Connect again.
    • 

  • Pick Slow (115200) under Speed.
    • 

  • Make sure no other program or browser tab has the port open.
    • 



It flashed, but the screen stays blank or keeps rebooting
    

  • Flash again with Erase the whole board first ticked.
    • 

  • Press EN once after flashing.
    • 



Going back to Meshtastic
  • Use the official flasher at flasher.meshtastic.org.
